before: An equation run or control whose w:rFonts slots named different faces showed a text fallback, without its face, size, or math style.
after: Such a run takes the face of the slots that its text uses and keeps its size and math style. A run whose text needs two faces keeps the text fallback.
reason: Only the local equation projection, geometry, and font selection change. Canonical OMML, offsets, operations, and collaboration data remain unchanged.
